scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands descendants of the solid bodies folder

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software has one solid body made by an extrusion from a sketch
the Solid Bodies folder shows the body, its extrusion and nested sketch
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Collapse All Children
the body row remains visible under the folder
the extrusion and sketch rows under the body are hidden
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Expand All Children
the body's extrusion and nested sketch rows are visible again
the solid remains visible in the same apparent view
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with its model browser visible
the user chooses Find from the model browser menu
the user chooses Sketches in the object type list
the user opens the Property list
the list offers Name, Note contents, Note title and Sketch Parameter Name
the user chooses Sketch Parameter Name
the Condition field displays contains
the Value field is empty and adds to list is disabled
the user opens the Condition list
it offers contains and does not contain
the user dismisses the list and closes the dialog
the model browser and part are visible

scenarios.scenario: Decline grouping an additional feature type

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software with the Find dialog open
the criteria list contains Type equals Extrusion OR Type equals Fillet
the criteria list contains Suppress status equals Suppressed
And is selected for additional criteria
the user chooses Type equals Hole and clicks Add to list
a prompt offers to group the additional type criterion using OR
the user chooses No
the prompt closes and the existing three criteria remain in the list
Type equals Hole is not added to the list
the property, condition and value controls still show Type equals Hole
the user closes the Find dialog
the part remains visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog contains these feature criteria in order:
the user selects the Suppress status criterion
the criterion controls show Suppress status, equals and Suppressed
And is selected
the user selects the Fillet criterion
the criterion controls show Type, equals and Fillet
Or is selected
the user selects the Extrusion criterion
the criterion controls show Type, equals and Extrusion
And is selected
the three criteria remain listed
the user closes the Find dialog
the part workspace is visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software Find dialog contains feature search criteria
the user chooses Save Search
a prompt shows an empty search-name field
OK is disabled and cancels is available
the user clicks Cancel
the Find dialog remains open with its criteria unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Inspect and cancels conditional feature suppression

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
an unsuppressed extrusion is selected in the MCAD Software model browser
the user chooses Properties from the extrusion context menu
Feature Properties shows the feature name and Suppress, Adaptive and Feature Appearance controls
Always and If are unchecked
the conditional suppression controls are disabled
the user checks If
the parameter selector, comparison operator and value field are enabled
OK is disabled while the comparison value is empty
the user opens the comparison operator list
it offers equals, not equals, less than, less than or equal, greater than and greater than or equal
the user chooses greater than or equal
that operator is displayed
the user clicks Cancel and reopens Feature Properties
If is unchecked and the conditional controls are disabled
the user clicks Cancel
the dialog closes and the solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch between unconditional and conditional suppression

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
an unsuppressed extrusion in the MCAD Software has Feature Properties open
Always and If are unchecked
the user checks Always
Always is checked and If is unchecked
the conditional controls are disabled
the user checks If
If is checked and Always is unchecked
the conditional controls are enabled
OK is disabled while the comparison value is empty
the user checks Always again
Always is checked and If is unchecked
the conditional controls are disabled and OK is enabled
the user clicks Cancel
the dialog closes and the solid remains visible
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
an extrusion in the MCAD Software has Feature Properties open
the Adaptive Sketch and Parameters options are unchecked
From/To Planes is disabled for this extrusion
the user checks Sketch and Parameters
both options are checked
From/To Planes remains disabled
the user clicks Cancel and reopens Feature Properties
Sketch and Parameters are unchecked
From/To Planes remains disabled
the user clicks Cancel
the dialog closes and the solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Create and switch model states in an empty part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
a new empty part is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser shows the expanded Model State branch with Primary active
the user opens the Model State branch context menu
it offers New Model State, Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user opens the New Model State submenu
it offers New Model State and Duplicate Primary
the user chooses New Model State
a new model-state entry appears and is active
its generated name is selected for inline editing
the user enters a new state name and presses Enter
the new name appears in the model-state row and branch label
the browser root and document tab identify the new state
the user double-clicks the Primary model-state entry
Primary is marked as active
the browser root and document tab identify Primary
the user double-clicks the new model-state entry
the new state is marked as active
the browser root and document tab identify the new state
the viewport remains empty
`fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
an empty part with Primary and a second model state is active in the MCAD Software
the second state is active and the edit scope is Single Member
the user clicks the edit-scope control on the Model State branch
its tooltip identifies All Members as the edit scope
the browser root indicates All
the second model state remains active
the user clicks the edit-scope control again
its tooltip identifies Single Member as the edit scope
the All indicator is removed from the browser root
the second model state remains active
the viewport remains empty

scenarios.scenario: Cancel adding a property to the model-state table

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
an empty part with Primary and two named model states is active in the MCAD Software
the Model State branch is expanded
the user chooses Edit Table from the Model State branch context menu
the model-state table dialog opens
its member table lists Primary and both named states
the member table has a Member column
the user selects the Properties category
the user selects Category under the Summary group
the user adds the selected property to the table
Category appears in the chosen-property list
a Category column appears in the member table
OK is enabled
the user cancels the dialog and reopens Edit Table
the member table has a Member column
it does not have a Category column
the user cancels the dialog
the same part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Accept a property column in the model-state table

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
an empty part with Primary and two named model states is active in the MCAD Software
the Model State branch is expanded
the model-state table has no Category column
the user chooses Edit Table from the Model State branch context menu
the user selects the Properties category
the user selects Category under the Summary group
the user adds the selected property to the table
Category appears in the chosen-property list
a Category column appears in the member table
the user accepts the table change
the user reopens Edit Table in the same session
the member table has Member and Category columns
it lists Primary and both named states
the user cancels the dialog
the same part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Accept and cancels edits to a model-state property cell

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user adds and accepts the Category property column in the model-state table
an empty part with Primary and two named model states is active in the MCAD Software
the second named state is active
the model-state table has a Category column with empty cells
the user opens the model-state table
the user double-clicks the active state's Category cell
the user enters "Prototype"
the cell displays "Prototype"
OK is enabled
the user accepts the table change
the user reopens the model-state table in the same session
the active state's Category cell displays "Prototype"
the other states' Category cells are empty
the user double-clicks the active state's Category cell
the user replaces its value with "Review"
the user cancels the table
the user reopens the model-state table
the active state's Category cell displays "Prototype"
the user cancels the table
the same part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Cancel removal of a model-state property column

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user adds and accepts the Category property column in the model-state table
the user sets the active state Category to Prototype and accepts the table
an empty part with multiple model states is active in the MCAD Software
its model-state table includes a Category column
the active state's Category value is "Prototype"
the user opens the model-state table and selects Properties
the user selects Category in the chosen-property list
the remove transfer control is enabled
the user removes the selected property from the table
Category disappears from the chosen-property list
the Category column disappears from the member table
OK is enabled
the user cancels the table and reopens it in the same session
the Category column is present
the active state's Category value is "Prototype"
the user cancels the table
the same part remains active
